news.title: Sharangovich breaks late tie as the Flames end the Hurricanes' 7-game winning streak
news.ruTitle: Шарангович разрывает позднюю ничью, когда «Флэймз» прервали победную серию «Харрикейнз» из 7 игр
news.description: — Yegor Sharangovich scored the go-ahead goal with 4:28 left and the Calgary Flames ended Carolina's seven-game winning streak, beating the defending champion Hurricanes 3-2 on Saturday night for their second victory of the season.

news.title: Kaprizov, Wallstedt carry the Wild past the Blue Jackets, 2-1
news.ruTitle: Капризов и Вальстедт обыграли «Уайлд» «Блю Джекетс» со счётом 2:1.
news.description: — Kirill Kaprizov broke a second-period tie with his NHL-leading 10th goal, Jesper Wallstedt stopped 13 shots and the Minnesota Wild beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 2-1 on Sunday night.

news.title: Bruins beat the Kings 4-1 for their 5th straight victory
news.ruTitle: «Брюинз» обыграли «Кингз» со счетом 4:1 и одержали пятую победу подряд.
news.description: — Marat Khusnutdinov scored in the third period and the Boston Bruins beat the Los Angeles Kings 4-1 on Saturday night for their fifth straight victory.

news.title: McDavid has 2 goals and 3 assists in the Oilers' 6-2 romp over the Mammoth
news.ruTitle: На счету Макдэвида 2 гола и 3 передачи в матче «Ойлерз» над «Мамонтом» со счетом 6:2.
news.description: — Connor McDavid had two goals and three assists and the Edmonton Oilers beat the Utah Mammoth 6-2 on Saturday night to split a home-and-home series.

news.title: Golden Knights rout Penguins 6-2 as Mark Stone nets a goal and 2 assists
news.ruTitle: «Голден Найтс» разгромили «Пингвинз» со счетом 6:2, Марк Стоун забил гол и сделал 2 результативные передачи
news.description: — Mark Stone had a goal and two assists, and the Vegas Golden Knights extended their strong start by romping past the slumping Pittsburgh Penguins 6-2 on Saturday night.
